args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Error toasts should use an assertive live region (e.g. render a separate role="alert"/aria-live="assertive" container for kind === "error", or set aria-live dynamically) and should not receive the AUTO_DISMISS_MS timeout in the Toast component — skip the setTimeout/auto-dismiss for item.kind === "error" so they persist until the user dismisses them.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.
Toast.tsx renders a single '<div className="toast-stack" role="status" aria-live="polite">' for all toast kinds, and the Toast sub-component unconditionally starts 'setTimeout(() => onDismiss(item.id), AUTO_DISMISS_MS)' for every item regardless of kind, matching the reported behavior exactly.
